sections.page_subtitle: Our studio operates under standards of technical rigour and artistic excellence. We answer your questions about the surgical and creative process behind your next piece.

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.answer: The minimum price per session is €150. The final cost is set after evaluating the technical complexity, the exact size and the anatomical placement of the design. We provide personalised quotes after the initial consultation.

questions.question: How long does healing take?
questions.answer: Surface epidermal regeneration takes 2 to 3 weeks. The deeper dermis, however, only stabilises internally after roughly 45 to 60 days.

questions.question: Does it hurt?
questions.answer: Pain perception is subjective and varies by area. We use precise application techniques to minimise tissue trauma. Being well hydrated and properly fed reduces sensitivity.

questions.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
questions.answer: We mainly work by appointment to guarantee the studio is prepared. We sometimes have slots for small pieces; we recommend calling ahead or checking our social stories.

questions.question: Can I bring my own design?
questions.answer: We accept references, but our artists always reinterpret the idea through their personal style and durability criteria to guarantee a top-tier piece.

questions.question: How do I care for a new tattoo?
questions.answer: Aftercare is essential. Wash with neutral soap, apply a thin layer of the recommended balm and avoid direct sun exposure or submerging the piece (pools/sea) for 15 days.

questions.question: Do you offer free touch-ups?
questions.answer: We offer one complimentary touch-up within the first 2 months if the artist deems it necessary, provided the post-session care instructions have been followed rigorously.

questions.question: What is your cancellation policy?
questions.answer: Deposits are non-refundable. We require at least 48 hours' notice to reschedule an appointment without forfeiting the booking deposit.

sections.page_subtitle: Aftercare decides how your tattoo will age. Follow this protocol to the letter during the first few weeks.

care_steps.title: Cleaning
care_steps.description: Wash 3 times a day with neutral soap and lukewarm water. Pat dry with disposable paper using gentle touches.

care_steps.title: Hydration
care_steps.description: Apply a very thin layer of the recommended balm. The skin needs to breathe; avoid excess product.

care_steps.title: Protection
care_steps.description: Avoid sun, pools, gyms and tight clothing during the first 10 days to prevent infection.

care_steps.title: Follow-up
care_steps.description: Any technical concern after the session must be discussed directly with the studio via WhatsApp.

sections.page_subtitle: Client safety is non-negotiable. These are the surgical standards we apply at every session.

protocol_items.title: Sterilisation
protocol_items.description: Medical-grade autoclave plus high-level chemical disinfection on every contact surface.

protocol_items.title: Disposable Material
protocol_items.description: Needles, cartridges, covers and barriers are 100% disposable and opened in front of the client at each session.

protocol_items.title: Aseptic Studio
protocol_items.description: We maintain a controlled environment under strict sanitary regulations, guaranteeing a contaminant-free space.
